title: Grateful Dead Live at Kezar Stadium on 1973-05-26

ai_review.summary: Decent‑quality recording captures a high‑energy 1973 performance with a standout He's Gone → Truckin' → The Other One sequence and sweet jams from Jerry and Phil.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the show’s tight, jam‑heavy flow, especially the He’s Gone‑Truckin’‑Other One‑Eyes‑China Doll‑Sugar Magnolia stretch. Jerry’s youthful tone and a prime Phil bass jam are highlighted, while no recording flaws are noted, suggesting a listenable source.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, positive reviews rate the show around 4‑4.5 stars and mention no audio problems, indicating good musical performance and acceptable recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific technical issues mentioned; recording presumed clear enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a strong, jam‑filled flow especially in the second‑half sequence, with smooth transitions and sustained energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Sounds young and youthful on guitar.
band_member_comments.Phil: Prime bass jam highlighted as a highlight.
